name: How long does a typical sewage cleanup project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical sewage cleanup project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a sewage cleanup project varies widely based on the severity of the damage, the size of the affected area, and the materials involved. A small backup might be cleaned and dried in 2-3 days, while extensive contamination affecting multiple rooms could take a week or more for complete remediation and drying. We will provide a more accurate timeline after our initial assessment of your property.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project duration varies, from 2-3 days for small backups to over a week for extensive contamination, depending on severity and area size.
